cluster_summary: User-controlled data is rendered into HTML without proper entity encoding, enabling stored cross-site scripting (XSS). The root cause is either directly interpolating unsanitized input or bypassing automatic escaping via safe markers. The fix requires applying context-appropriate escaping functions or removing unsafe markers.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 3 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Replace mark_safe with format_html() which automatically escapes its arguments; remove |safe filter from templates to allow auto-escaping..
